reviews.title: Cool Sound and Looks!
reviews.comment: I often am on Zoom sessions and also create multimedia products that require narration. The Blue Yeti mic has been perfect for all of this.  And, it looks really cool in video conferences, so be sure to pull it close enough so the other participants can see it!
reviews.author: OregonJeff

reviews.title: Extremely good
reviews.comment: I would highly highly highly highly recommend this I’m not a robot, but like this is the best microphone that a new artist or anybody who’s trying to get into music or something that requires your voice to be crisp really well Get some good headphones with it as well and you got a pretty good set up
reviews.author: Bry
